extensionDescription.message: Organize tabs by website, manage multi-window tabs, remove duplicates, save pages, and capture selected text with highlights.

extensionFullDescription.message:
Tabloom is a Chrome tab management extension for people who work with dozens of tabs. It organizes tabs by website within each browser window and brings tabs from all your windows together in a focused new-tab workspace.
Find pages quickly, remove duplicates, save tabs for later, capture important text, and keep your browser easier to manage.
Core Features
Group tabs by website domain within each Chrome window
View and jump between tabs across multiple browser windows
Detect and remove duplicate web pages
Save pages for later reading with queue and archive views
Optionally organize newly opened tabs automatically; disabled by default
Optionally discard idle tabs using Chrome’s native memory-saving API; disabled by default
Use quick links for Google, Baidu, and custom websites
Display localhost ports to distinguish local development environments
Configure ignored domains, blocked domains, grouping rules, themes, and accent colors
Use the new-tab command center to view grouped tabs, quick links, saved pages, clipboard history, and settings
Switch between English and Simplified Chinese
Selection Clipboard
Select text on ordinary HTTP or HTTPS web pages
Choose a highlighter color from the Tabloom selection palette
Automatically copy and save selected text locally
Restore saved highlights when revisiting the same page using URL, XPath, and text context
Review clipboard history by Today, Yesterday, or specific dates
Delete records, undo deletions, or open the original source page
Re-copy any saved selection with one click
Pin up to five important selections
Add private notes to saved selections
Copy selected text together with the page title and source URL
Export clipboard records as Markdown or JSON
View and manage clipboard history directly from the new-tab homepage
Turn the selection clipboard on or off from the control panel
Highlight restoration is best effort. It may not work if a website substantially changes its content or page structure. The selection clipboard does not run on restricted Chrome pages, input fields, textareas, or editable areas.
Why Install Tabloom?
Tabloom helps reduce the time spent searching through crowded browser windows and manually organizing pages. The new-tab command center gives you one place to review active tabs, saved pages, quick links, clipboard records, and settings.
The selection clipboard is useful for research, development, writing, study, and everyday browsing. Capture a useful passage, highlight it, add a note, pin it, copy it again later, or return to its original page.
All core logic runs locally inside Chrome. Tabloom does not use an external backend and does not send your browsing history, tab titles, URLs, or clipboard records to the developer.
Settings and saved pages use Chrome storage. Clipboard records remain in local browser storage, are limited to 500 records, and are not synchronized through Chrome Sync. Markdown and JSON exports are generated locally in your browser.
Tabloom helps you organize your browsing without giving up control of your personal data.
